portfolioDescription: This project is the portfolio you are currently viewing. This is the second version of it.
amicoockedDescription: A revolutionary culinary application developed with Flutter. « Am I Cooked » allows users to discover new recipes, manage their favorites, and track their culinary progress through an integrated gamification system.
ymmovDescription: This API is the REST backend for the Ymmo project (a project aimed at installing and configuring numerous web and infrastructure solutions for a group of real estate agencies across France), developed with Spring Boot (Java 26) to manage users, properties, transactions, and favorites. The entire setup revolves around a containerized architecture via Docker Compose, integrating a pre-configured PostgreSQL database via a SQL script and a S3-compatible file system (RustFS) for object storage. Secured by JWT tokens and easily exploratory thanks to its Swagger interface.
vinodomiaDescription: SaaS for vineyard domains and viticulturists to assist them in managing stock and cash flow.
pictoflutterchatDescription: A re-interpretation of Nintendo's PictoChat DS application for mobile phones.
chatperlipopetteDescription: A mobile Flutter application allowing users to discover cat breeds from around the world, locate shelters and available kittens, and share their favorite discoveries.
groupietrackerDescription: A web application using a Golang HTTP server and Go Templates to fetch information about music groups via an API and display it on an artist page template.
